Lock food level for players in the lobby or spectator area.

There is no reason why food should be a thing in the lobby or spectator area. This commit effectively disables it for players in those places/states, while retaining the in-arena conditional logic based on the config-file setting.

Fixes #514

diff --git a/src/main/java/com/garbagemule/MobArena/ArenaListener.java b/src/main/java/com/garbagemule/MobAre...

result.reasoning: This commit refactored onFoodLevelChange and dropped the previous `!arena.inArena((Player) event.getEntity())` check that ensured only players actually in the arena were affected by the food-level lock. After this change, when `arena.isRunning()` and `lockFoodLevel` is true, the event is cancelled for the given player regardless of whether they are actually in the arena, affecting everyone on the server. The fix commit directly restores this missing check by adding `arena.inArena(p) &&` to the condition.
